subject.title: Discord account-to-agent routing falls back to default agent instead of matching by account name

question: Should OpenClaw add an implicit Discord-only same-name account-to-agent fallback when no explicit binding matches, or require explicit bindings for this permission boundary?
rationale: Current docs and source define explicit account bindings before default-agent fallback; changing that behavior affects security-sensitive agent, session, model/provider, and tool-policy routing.

options.title: Approve guarded Discord fallback
options.body: Add the fallback only for non-default Discord accounts that exactly match a configured agent, with a distinct matchedBy value, tests, docs, and live proof.

options.title: Keep explicit bindings only
options.body: Treat the current behavior as the supported security boundary and resolve this as documentation or setup guidance instead of runtime fallback.

options.title: Add setup or doctor assist
options.body: Keep runtime routing explicit but offer to generate safe bindings for same-name Discord accounts during setup or doctor repair.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded Discord fallback
recommendation.body: Add the fallback only for non-default Discord accounts that exactly match a configured agent, with a distinct matchedBy value, tests, docs, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the multi-agent routing and docs contract that steipete introduced and has repeatedly maintained.
